diagnosis.hosted_exception: Root43460083439 scheduler traceback was never captured (no VM/log authority). Not claimed as proven hosted exception; the local reproduction below is the same real entry point and matches the captured symptom (scheduler exits, docker restart_count 3->5).
diagnosis.reproduced_cause: On a cold search-svc the embedding model integrity hashing + ONNX load (LocalEmbeddingEngine.is_ready) was paid lazily by the first request (readyz probe or the scheduler's first /api/search/index/refresh). On a CPU-limited cold start this exceeds the scheduler's 30s per-request boundary, so urlopen raised TimeoutError, main() had no handler, the process exited and docker restart:unless-stopped looped it. Also the compose readyz healthcheck has a 5s timeout and hit the same cold cost.
